I froze her card right there at the poker table. She couldn't cover her debt. The casino owner had her dragged to the back room and held for three days as collateral.

When Vincent found out, he just brushed his fingers across my cheek and smiled.

"Baby, why are you competing with a little girl? You're better than that."

He didn't punish me. Didn't even seem angry. Instead, he told me we'd celebrate my birthday at his new underground casino—the one I'd helped him secure the permits for, the one I'd made sure the cops would ignore.

Tonight was supposed to be special. I'd finally decided to tell Vincent the truth—that I wasn't Anna Bennett, the nobody from nowhere. I was Liliana Salvatore, heir to the Salvatore family, the most powerful and feared crime dynasty in North America. The family
